content: Both Framer Motion (motion/react) and GSAP require 'use client' wrapper components in Next.js App Router since RSC pages are server components by default -- no advantage to either on that specific axis. motion package (v13.0.0, formerly framer-motion) has full React 19 support including fixes for React 19 reorder/unmount behavior. GSAP (v3.15.0, gsap npm pkg) also works via Server-Component-safe wrapper patterns and became 100% free (incl. ScrollTrigger, SplitText) since Webflow acquired GreenSock in Oct 2024, license changed April 2025. Framer Motion favored for declarative gesture/layout/exit animations matching React's component model (best fit for scroll-reveal + AnimatePresence-driven chat sequencing); GSAP favored for complex imperative timelines/SVG morphing. Bundle: Motion with LazyMotion+m can ship ~4.6KB initial, full motion component ~32KB gzip; GSAP core ~23KB gzip + ScrollTrigger adds more.
